Web · /board-sizes · Wisconsin Creative

Board drawings, fixed

Every board now draws at its true proportions, zone labels stop piling up, and picking a zone works by click or tap, not just hover.

Side by side

Before is the page after the internal-use cut, captured earlier today. After differs only by this change. Same manifest (2026-10-08.1), Chromium, light mode, 1× scale, and the same viewport and clip.

After only

No matched baseline for these: the distorted versions were seen in earlier working captures that weren't kept. What was wrong: the HD feed (16:9) drew as a portrait rectangle, Section A (336 × 264) about 660 px tall, and the IPTV Video Wall Ad (960 × 1080) about 950 px tall.

What changed, and why

Proportions

Was

The drawing's height came from a percentage that resolved against the card, not the narrowed figure. Anything not much wider than tall was stretched tall.

Now

A sizer inside the figure carries the aspect ratio. Tall boards cap at 260 px; ribbons stay at least 8 px.

Nested zones

Was

Alternative layouts of one area (Frame-Left around the wing and ads; Two Thirds around 1080s) all centered their labels in the same spot.

Now

A zone that holds others labels its top-left corner. If the zones inside fill more than half of it, its label shows only on hover or pick.

Overlapping labels

Was

Partly overlapping zones printed labels over each other.

Now

After layout (and on every resize), a label that would overlap a smaller zone's label hides until hovered.

Picking

Was

Highlighting only worked on hover, so touch got nothing; clicking a zone scrolled the list to center it.

Now

Click or tap a zone or its row to pick it. Full-board zones (Fullscreen, Borders) outline the whole board. The list scrolls only as far as needed. Escape clears the pick.

Logic

Was

Search matches and hover shared one class, so leaving a row in search mode left its zone lit. Hover and pick repeated the same lookup. There were two one-line aliases (cardId, boardCount).

Now

Search matches use their own class. One eachZone helper serves hover and pick. The aliases are gone.

Verification

  • tests/static-tools.test.ts: 46 passed
  • node scripts/hash-static-tools.mjs: app.js restamped
  • npm run verify:docs (exit 0) and git diff --check: pass
  • Playwright: row hover lights its zone and clears on leave; clicking a zone picks it and its row; clicking a row picks it; Escape clears; picking Borders lights .zone-whole; ?q=1920x1080 marks 3 drawn zones and 3 rows; no page errors
  • All 27 drawings across the five venues captured after the final change and checked by eye, light mode; picked states also checked in dark mode
  • Corner labels: only Club Board shows them (1080 Left, 1080 Right); none at Kohl Center, Field House, LaBahn or Goodman

Things to know

  • Ribbon boards (fascias, the 360 Fascia) draw at the 8 px minimum, so their zones carry no labels; the list below names them. A zoom-on-hover for ribbons would be the next geometry improvement.
  • Not done: search by id or key, and Back-button history.
